steps.name: Given user is on the Swag Labs login page
When user logs in with username "standard_user" and password "secret_sauce"
Then user should be navigated to the products page
When the user adds "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
When the user goes to the cart
Then the product "Sauce Labs Backpack" should be present in the cart
When the user clicks on the checkout button
When the user enters "Deepak" "Kumar" "123" as checkout details
And the user clicks the continue button
